title: the update's size check on a site's database roles
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's local runs (a local PostgreSQL 16 cluster with the roles made by the install's own db-init scripts, git ancestry of the walk box's releases); the bench host, Docker and the box rehearsal were not run.

findings.claim: the walk box's update ran its installed release's update.py (apply_update.sh runs the installed tree), installed before H-99: it read pg_database_size('hapi') as trialbox on trialbox_wf, refused on a site's roles with the walk's exact error; master's reads were already right, so a box installed before a9cc50c9 cannot update until it is reinstalled once
findings.fix: one reinstall with the bootstrap on such a box (the walk did it); the walk's next update is the proof

findings.claim: nothing in CI runs an update with the previous release's update path (the box rehearsal installs and never updates; the update drill runs the in-process box), so a fault in an installed release's update path is first seen on a real box
findings.fix: a rehearsal case that installs the previous master's bundle and updates to the pull request's: a card of its own (question to the integrator)

findings.claim: ComposeBox's size reads never ran against the box's real database container in CI; the rehearsal's doctor phase now checks that trialbox cannot connect to hapi and that db_size reads both databases with DB_SIZE_ROLES through the box's own command line
findings.fix: H-121 (this card); the rehearsal job on its pull request is the first run

findings.claim: space_needs still counts 0 for a size answer that is not a number (psql succeeded but printed none); making it a stop changes the fakes of nine update tests in three other test files, so it is left as before
findings.fix: not in this card (question to the integrator)

findings.claim: the change was not run on the bench host, with Docker or in the box rehearsal: the size reads ran on a local PostgreSQL 16 cluster with the roles of the install's own db-init scripts; the rehearsal check's seconds are an estimate
findings.fix: the rehearsal job on the pull request, and the walk's next update on the bench host
